residualCalculation: (native context sec − generation anchor context sec) × 1000 − (native performance ms − generation anchor performance ms). Rule: abs(residual) ≤ 20 ms after checking that the native timestamp advances. Exact rational input and rule, displayed numeric summaries round to nearest binary float. Percentiles are nearest rank.
